name: initial_schema
description: Create initial database schema for AI Memory Palace context storage
up_sql:
-- Create contexts table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS contexts (
    project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_data TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    checksum TEXT NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (project_id, session_id)
);

-- Create context_events table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS context_events (
    event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    metadata TEXT,
    correlation_id TEXT,
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id, session_id) REFERENCES contexts(project_id, session_id)
);

-- Create context_metadata table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS context_metadata (
    project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    project_name TEXT,
    project_type TEXT,
    last_accessed TEXT,
    context_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    total_size_bytes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    metadata TEXT,
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Create indexes for performance
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_contexts_timestamp ON contexts(timestamp);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_contexts_updated ON contexts(updated_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_timestamp ON context_events(timestamp);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_type ON context_events(event_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_correlation ON context_events(correlation_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_metadata_accessed ON context_metadata(last_accessed);

-- Create triggers for updated_at timestamps
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS update_contexts_timestamp 
    AFTER UPDATE ON contexts
    BEGIN
        UPDATE contexts SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE project_id = NEW.project_id AND session_id = NEW.session_id;
    END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS update_metadata_timestamp 
    AFTER UPDATE ON context_metadata
    BEGIN
        UPDATE context_metadata SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE project_id = NEW.project_id;
    END;
